# Shared cases: the playback queue's edits and shuffle, on entry ids.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/queue_edits_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/models/queue_edits_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <ids> <current> <original>  <op> <a> <b>  <ids> <current> <original>
#
# A queue is its entry ids in play order, the position of the current one
# (-1 when empty), and the ids before shuffle (- when not shuffled). Lists are
# comma-separated, `.` is an empty list. The result is a lone `-` (then the
# last two fields are absent) when the edit leaves the queue alone.
#
# op: insertNext <count> | append <count> | removeUpNextAt <index>
#     | reorderUpNext <from> <to> | removeWhere <ids to remove>
#     | shuffle <seed> | unshuffle
# Unused arguments are `-`.

0,1,2	0	-	insertNext	1	-	0,3,1,2	0	-

2,0,1	0	0,1,2	insertNext	1	-	2,3,0,1	0	0,1,2,3
2,0,1	0	0,1,2	insertNext	2	-	2,3,4,0,1	0	0,1,2,3,4
2,0,1	0	0,1,2	append	1	-	2,0,1,3	0	0,1,2,3
